455:t_3:15.en:
$$ジン$$
「Lecturing $$カグラ$$ about common sense is pointless.」

455:t_3:16.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Shut up, $$ジン$$. Now that old man $$不動$$ is gone, I'm doing things my way.」

455:t_3:17.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Looks like that old man has been jerking you around too.」

455:t_3:18.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh... Yeah, you could say that. Is it the same on your end?」

455:t_3:19.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Looks like that old man named $$不動$$ is a pain in every era.」

455:t_3:20.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「As expected of $$カグラ$$, who took after $$アポロ$$'s wild child side so strongly. They're already in perfect sync.」

455:t_3:21.en:
$$シン$$
「Still, I wonder if Commander $$不動$$ of $$ディーバ$$ and Supreme Commander $$不動$$ of $$ネオディーヴァ$$ are related after all...」

455:t_3:22.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「A blood relative... or a reincarnation, probably.」

455:t_3:23.en:
$$キラ$$
「They're both unpredictable, showing up and vanishing whenever they please. That's another way they're alike.」

455:t_3:24.en:
$$カグラ$$
「But that old man is gone now!」

455:t_3:25.en:
$$アポロ$$
「From here on, the world is ours!」

455:t_3:27.en:
$$カグラ$$
「You got a problem with that, $$アマタ$$!?」

455:t_3:28.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You're saying you're going to stop us?」

455:t_3:29.en:
$$カグラ$$
「No way, no way...! This guy's a wimp about everything except when it comes to $$ミコノ$$!」

455:t_3:30.en:
$$アポロ$$
「And this guy is my reincarnation, huh... Pathetic, even for me.」

455:t_3:31.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Looking at $$アポロ$$, I kind of think so myself.」

455:t_3:32.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Anyway, this one here seems pretty angry about you sniffing around earlier.」

455:t_3:33.en:
$$シリウス$$
「$$カグラ$$, was it...? If you're going to be rude to my sister $$シルヴィア$$, you'll answer to me, $$シリウス・ド・アリシア$$.」

455:t_3:35.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Then I'll take care of training this stray.」

455:t_3:39.en:
$$ジン$$
「Looks like the two of them have their new owners now.」

455:t_3:40.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「What have you been up to since you and I parted ways, $$ジン$$?」

455:t_3:41.en:
$$ジン$$
「Nothing but $$エレメント$$ ability training. Unlike you, $$ユノハ$$, we've barely had any training at $$聖天使学園$$.」

455:t_3:42.en:
$$クレア$$
「I was the one supervising it.」

455:t_3:43.en:
$$シュレード$$
「It's been a while for you too, Chairwoman.」

455:t_3:44.en:
$$クレア$$
「With $$不動$$ absent, I will take command of both $$アクエリオン$$s.」

455:t_3:45.en:
$$クレア$$
「Now then, the $$エレメント$$s from $$ディーバ$$, please introduce yourselves.」

455:t_3:46.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I'm $$シリウス・ド・アリシア$$. Many of you already know me, but please look after me and my sister $$シルヴィア$$ once again.」

455:t_3:47.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I'm $$シルヴィア・ド・アリシア$$. Since $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$ can't transform, I'll devote myself to supporting $$アポロ$$ this time.」

455:t_3:48.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Aren't you going to say 'My ideal man is Brother $$シリウス$$'?」

455:t_3:50.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Quit saying dumb stuff. There are people waiting behind you.」

455:t_3:51.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'm $$アポロ$$. Well... nice to meet you.」

455:t_3:52.en:
$$ファ$$
($$アポロ$$... Looks like he covered for $$シルヴィア$$.)

455:t_3:53.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(Looks like those two are getting along.)

455:t_3:54.en:
$$アンディ$$
「But setting aside $$アポロ$$ and $$シリウス$$, who were sleeping in the gap between dimensions...」

455:t_3:55.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「how did $$シルヴィア$$ get to this era...?」

455:t_3:56.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I'm not sure myself, but I think it was Commander $$不動$$'s power.」

455:t_3:57.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「The Commander from $$ディーバ$$?」

455:t_3:58.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Yeah... He showed up out of nowhere, like always, and asked me if I wanted to see $$アポロ$$...」

455:t_3:59.en:
$$モロイ$$
「And you said yes, and got sent to this world 12,000 years later?」

455:t_3:60.en:
$$アンディ$$
「That Commander $$不動$$ of yours is something else too.」

455:t_3:61.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「But was that okay? You had friends and family in the world 12,000 years ago, didn't you?」

455:t_3:62.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Yeah... ...I may never see $$麗花$$, $$ピエール$$, and the others again...」

455:t_3:63.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Even so, I wanted to see him.」

455:t_3:66.en:
$$シン$$
「So you're not denying that you wanted to see $$アポロ$$.」

455:t_3:67.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's huge progress for someone like $$シルヴィア$$.」

455:t_3:69.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「No way! I love that kind of thing!」

455:t_3:70.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I understand... how you feel, $$シルヴィア$$.」

455:t_3:71.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「A forbidden love for her brother, across 12,000 years...! So moe...!」

455:t_3:72.en:
$$モロイ$$
「One person here has got it wrong...!」

455:t_3:73.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Whatever. From now on, we'll be relying on this $c.」

455:t_3:74.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Are you sure? Deciding so easily.」

455:t_3:75.en:
$$アポロ$$
「The future that $$シリウス$$, $$頭翅#pilot$$, and I risked our lives to protect is a part of this world, right?」

455:t_3:76.en:
$$アポロ$$
「If anyone wants to do whatever they please with it, like the guys we fought today, I'll take them on.」

455:t_3:77.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I feel the same. I'll fight with $$アクエリオン$$ for the sake of this world.」

455:t_3:78.en:
$$アンディ$$
「$$神話型アクエリオン$$ has joined us. Now we've got nothing to be afraid of!」

455:t_3:79.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Your $$アクエリオン$$ isn't half bad either.」

455:t_3:80.en:
$$クレア$$
「Certainly, $$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$ was developed based on $$神話型アクエリオン$$, but...」

455:t_3:81.en:
$$クレア$$
「Since the source of $$アクエリオン$$'s power is the pilots' feelings, the difference in combat strength between machines is negligible.」

455:t_3:82.en:
$$カグラ$$
「In other words, if $$ＥＶＯＬ$$ loses to Solar, it's $$アマタ$$'s fault.」

455:t_3:84.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's okay... I'm sure $$アマタ$$ can fight just as well as $$アポロ$$.」

455:t_3:86.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「You said earlier that you're pathetic, but I don't think that at all.」

455:t_3:87.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Because $$アマタ$$ always protects me and gives me courage.」

455:t_3:89.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll keep protecting you from now on. That's the one thing I promise.」

455:t_3:93.en:
$$ジン$$
「Don't worry about it, it's always like this.」

455:t_3:32: こちら (who is angry) rendered 'this one here'; presumably Sirius (speaks next) but kept vague.
455:t_3:72: 一人 (which person is mistaken) kept unspecified.
uncertain: 455:t_3:63: object of 会いたかった omitted in Japanese; I wrote 'him' (Apollo) since row 58 and Kagura's reply settle it.
455:t_3:35-39: Cayenne's 野良犬 taken as Kagura, with 二人 in Jin's line meaning Kagura and Apollo; who each owner is was left vague.
455:t_3:44: 不動 without title kept as $$不動$$ (Neo DEAVA's Fudou presumably).
455:t_3:71: 萌える rendered 'moe' as Sazanka's otaku tic.
ピエール is not in the glossary; proposed $$ピエール$$ (Pierre).
